[gbr+18] 是帧延时计数而非状态请求：f_0605D670 在 0x0605D678 读它并置 [gbr+19]=[gbr+18]-1，任务循环 0x0605D6B0 在 [gbr+19]>=0 时反复 jsr [gbr+972]。这就是 6-VBlank 周期的来源。

resolved_blocker.root_cause: 上游 runtime/src/machine/cdrom.cpp 的 CueFile 只有一个 audio 标志，但每读到一条 TRACK 行都执行 f.audio = cur_audio（f 为"当前 FILE"）。本盘是一个 BIN 内 13 轨（1 条 MODE1/2352 + 12 条 AUDIO），最后一条 AUDIO 使整个文件 audio=true，于是 cdrom_is_audio(166)（数据区）返回真，cdblock 的 cd_tick() 只走音频分支，deliver_sector() 永不调用，扇区永远进不了缓冲：Get Part Size(0x51) 的 out[3] 恒为 0，游戏无限轮询 Get Status(0x00)/0x51。
resolved_blocker.contradiction_evidence: 同一文件里轨级的 audio（CueTrack::audio -> ctrladr 0x41/0x01，TOC 侧）是正确的，运行时内部自相矛盾，故判为缺陷而非设计。
resolved_blocker.fix: patches/0001-cdrom-is-audio-per-track.patch —— cdrom_is_audio() 改为按轨（起始地址不超过 fad 的最后一条轨）判定；对一轨一文件的 CUE 新旧结果一致。

p1_006_true_overlay_swap.root_cause: the game swaps TRUE.BIN in over PROG.BIN at 0x06020000; game.toml declared only PROG, so the runtime kept executing PROG's recompiled code, which read TRUE's header word 0x06040C40 as the length of its {30, pointer} SCU-DMA triple table and built 21,912 records, running past the end of work RAM at 0x060FFFFF into the 1 MiB mirror at 0x06100320 - which folds onto the BIOS service slots 0x06000320..0x0600034C that PROG then calls through
not_the_cause: the BIOS slot range being too wide

p1_007_program_return.root_cause: core.cpp treats any call to a module base as a program start and throws ProgramStart, unwinding the host stack. This game's loader does 06004200 mov.l #0x06020000,r8 / 06004202 jsr @r8 and expects a return to 06004206, so the program's rts landed nowhere: 'FATAL the program at 06020000 returned' whenever a key ended the opening movie
p1_007_program_return.fix: patches/0003-call-into-swapped-module-returns.patch (14 lines): where the image at the base identifies a known module that has an entry at that address, make it an ordinary nested call (activate, then call); otherwise keep the program-start semantics
verification: after: hook P0:06004206 hits once at vb=1616 (the return), P0 re-activates PROG at 28.148 s, and the game reaches a map
no-input path unchanged: shot-1800/shot-2900 still the same earth MD5 as before the patch
